import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)
    
    bestError = 2e9
    target = x / y
    bestNum = 0
    bestDen = 1
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        approx = round(target * i)
        error = abs(approx / i - target)
        
        if error < bestError:
            bestError = error
            bestNum = approx
            bestDen = i
    
    print(f"{bestNum}/{bestDen}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
